## Linked issue
Related to #...

## Why / what changed
Two or three sentences; precise functional impact.

## Scope and affected contracts
Paths, interfaces, schema migrations, configuration changes.

## Evidence
Exact commands, run IDs, input/output hashes, old/new counts and measured impact.

## Tests
- [ ] Unit: <command and actual outcome>
- [ ] Integration/contract: <command and actual outcome>
- [ ] Lint/type/format: <command and actual outcome>
- [ ] Smoke/preflight: <command and actual outcome>
- [ ] Reproducibility and new run ID verified

## Risk, security and rollback
What could go wrong, monitoring, permissions, fallback/recovery plan.

## Explicitly not done
Untested hardware, full run not started, no paper/results claim, pending review.

## Review requests
What specifically should reviewers inspect? Which assumptions need approval?
